notes: Supply Dump Demolition Table: one die, modified, against the percentage of each supply type in the dump destroyed. As printed; errata E-032 (SPI September 1979) replaces the -1 and 7 columns (printed 33) with 0 and 100

Modifiers, cumulative across groups: +1 per extra third of basic CPA spent; +1 full (non-shell) division or -1 attempting units total 1 SP or less; -2 in a major city hex, otherwise +1 if the dump holds 500 points or fewer or -1 if 4000 or more; +1 if the attempting units have just captured the dump or -1 if not just captured and the nearest enemy unit is at least 20 CP away by medium truck

Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 108) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p14): 0 of 11 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
